name: Ammonium cocoyl isethionate
description: Ammonium cocoyl isethionate (CAS 223705-57-5 ), commercially available as Jordapon ACI 30 and Jordapon ACI 30G, is a mild, coconut-derived anionic surfactant used as a primary cleansing agent. Its low irritation profile makes it a preferred alternative to sulfate-based surfactants for sensitive-skin product lines. In rinse-off personal care, it functions as the primary surfactant in solid and liquid cleansers, shampoo bars, and baby wash formulations where mildness is a key requirement. Body wash and facial cleanser manufacturers use it to achieve dense, stable lather without harshness. In syndets, it provides the structural and cleansing backbone, enabling soap-free bar formats with a defined pH range suited to skin compatibility. Home care formulators incorporate it into mild dishwashing and surface cleaning products where skin contact is a design consideration. Ammonium cocoyl isethionate is supplied in two principal commercial forms: as a liquid dispersion (Jordapon ACI 30, approximately 30% active) and as a granular solid (Jordapon ACI 30G). The latter is preferred for solid bar manufacturing. Both forms are available in cosmetic and personal care grade meeting industry quality standards for use in finished consumer products. This surfactant is highly valued for its ability to maintain high performance while ensuring consumer safety and skin comfort. The material is compatible with a wide range of other surfactants, allowing for versatile formulation strategies in both liquid and solid formats.
